discussionQuestions.question: What part of this story impacted you most?
What voice distracts you most from hearing Jesus?

author: Mr. Leonard Abraham

sections.heading: Observe
sections.body: Jesus took Peter, James, and John up a high mountain. Moses and Elijah appeared with Him. God's voice said: "This is My beloved Son; hear Him!" Jesus touched the fearful disciples and told them not to be afraid.

sections.heading: Interpret
sections.body: The disciples saw Jesus' true glory. Moses and Elijah pointed to Jesus as the fulfilment of Scripture. God commands us to hear Jesus above every other voice.

sections.heading: Apply
sections.body: God separates us from distractions before giving revelation. Worship Jesus, trust Him, and obey His Word daily.

quiz.question: Who appeared with Jesus on the mountain?
quiz.explanation: Moses and Elijah represented the Law and the Prophets.

quiz.question: What did God's voice say?

options.option: This is My beloved Son; hear Him!
This is My beloved Son; hear Him!

quiz.explanation: The Father confirmed Jesus' identity and commanded obedience to Him.

quiz.question: What did Jesus do when the disciples were afraid?

options.option: He touched them and told them not to be afraid
He touched them and told them not to be afraid

quiz.explanation: Jesus comforted them with His presence.

title: Matthew 17:1-9 — The Mount of Transfiguration
description: A cell fellowship study on seeing Jesus clearly, hearing Him fully, and following Him faithfully.
